hero.title: <first>Restocking,</first> <second>handled.</second>
hero.text: Copacker forecasts your inventory, sends purchase orders just in time so you don’t run out, and handles the handoffs to your forwarder, Amazon FBA and AWD, with every label and document made for you.
hero.shotCaption: Copacker’s Restock page: two products from Shenzhen Metalworks to reorder, with order quantities, a {cost} estimated cost, and about {lost} in sales at risk before reorders arrive.

forecast.title: Know when to reorder.
forecast.text: Copacker forecasts every product from your Amazon, Shopify and eBay sales, and works back from your supplier’s lead time to the day you need to order.

agents.title: Built for AI agents.
agents.text: Copacker’s MCP server works with any agent, so yours can plan, order and ship right alongside you. Your partners’ agents post their updates too.

cost.question: What does Copacker cost?
cost.answer: Nothing right now. There are no paid plans, and signing up doesn’t ask for a card.

stores.question: Which stores does it work with?
stores.answer: Amazon, Shopify and eBay. Copacker reads your sales and stock from each.

warehouse.question: Can I ship to my own warehouse or a 3PL?
warehouse.answer: Yes. A purchase order can go to any of your delivery addresses instead of Amazon. Link an address to a Shopify location, and what you’ve ordered shows as on order there.

locations.question: Does Restock plan for my other locations?
locations.answer: Yes. It plans for each of your Shopify locations as well as Amazon, and a reorder for a location goes straight to it.

tracking.question: How do I track shipments outside Amazon?
tracking.answer: Your supplier marks the shipment shipped, your forwarder adds the carrier and tracking number, and you mark it received, all on the purchase order.

forwarders.question: Does it work with freight forwarders?
forwarders.answer: Yes. Your forwarder gets its own workspace, downloads the invoice and labels, and marks each shipment shipped with its carrier, tracking number and freight cost.

suppliers.question: Do my suppliers need an account?
suppliers.answer: No. They can work in Copacker for free, or you can fill in their side of the order yourself.

awd.question: Does it ship to AWD?
awd.answer: Yes. Copacker plans shipments to FBA and AWD, including AWD warehouses in China and Vietnam.

documents.question: Which documents and labels does it make?
documents.answer: Purchase orders, packing lists, and FNSKU, carton, shipping and warning labels, alongside the commercial invoice from your supplier.

mcp.question: What’s MCP?
mcp.answer: The Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI agents to apps. Copacker’s MCP server works with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code and any other MCP client.

cli.question: Is there a CLI?
cli.answer: Yes. The copacker CLI reads and acts on the same data as the app, for your scripts and coding agents.

setups.claudeCode: Run this, then sign in with {command} in Claude Code.
setups.codex: Run this and sign in when Codex asks. The CLI, the IDE extension and the ChatGPT desktop app share it.
setups.cursor: Add Copacker to Cursor’s MCP file, then sign in from Customize.
setups.vsCode: Add Copacker to your workspace’s MCP file, then start it from the file and sign in.
setups.gemini: Run this, then sign in with {command}.
setups.windsurf: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. Open its MCP config file from the MCPs menu and add Copacker.
setups.zed: Add Copacker to Zed’s settings, or add it as a remote server under Settings, AI, MCP Servers.
setups.openCode: Add Copacker to OpenCode’s config file. It signs in the first time it connects.

deliver.title: Delivered to FBA, and to you.
deliver.text: Your forwarder takes Amazon’s cartons to FBA, and FedEx brings the rest to your warehouse.
